headline: Pleasant fall Thursday on Table Rock — mild temps and reliable fishing bite
lede: Thursday, October 15 brings comfortable mid-October weather with a high near 77°F and lows in the upper 50s. A 55% chance of light showers early gives way to partly sunny skies — ideal for lake time, a show, or indoor attractions with a light jacket.

featured.title: Fall Fishing on Table Rock
featured.where: Main lake points and coves near Notch Lane
featured.why: Post-front conditions often improve the bite for bass and walleye. Use shallow crankbaits or jigs near brush. Check current USACE levels before heading out.
